{{Top|leg}}
'''Sand-kivers''' were a type of pest that appeared to be able to sense trouble a few seconds before it occurred. In a conversation with the [[Meetra Surik|Jedi Exile]], the [[HK-series assassin droid|Hunter-Killer]] [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]], [[HK-47]], once compared these creatures to [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], with regards to their similar ability of detecting future difficulties.
